verdict.rationale: Tavily ships an SDK, CLI, and MCP server, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. Usage logs, Project IDs, and session/user identifiers are account-side usage attribution features, and PII-blocking validation layers are an adjacent privacy control, so none of them count as an opt-out mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
